title: Ganbare Goemon Kirakira Dōchū: Boku ga Dancer ni Natta Wake -  Snow
description:
A Layer 3 Snow that appears on Lifski Ravine of Planet Sweah from Ganbare Goemon 4.

Because the Layer 3 autoscrolls, you'll need to use a workaround such as RAM toggled status bar, remove it or use Kevin's UberASM Retry System. Or any status bar that doesn't use layer 3 tiles.

Requested by Anorakun.
